usage_rows.rationale: Help and verbosity are the approved reporting controls.
The operation discriminant forms its own invocation row.
Input selection, format, reference, and prefix are one approved input group.
Distribution-method controls are one readable mode-specific group.
Fragment and normalized-coverage controls are one readable mode-specific group.
The output-formatting control ends the projection.
Help and verbosity are the approved reporting controls.
The required primary input, optional paired input, and header-prefix control form the input group.
Pseudocount selection, filtering, and symmetry controls form one mode-specific group.
Finite-value rendering and optional JSON representation form the output-formatting group.
Help and no-write preview are the approved invocation controls.
The workflow discriminant, part-file input list, and output target form the required execution tuple.
The lifecycle controls remain together after the required execution tuple.

reporting_order.rationale: report_plan reports ordered files and lifecycle effects, not a parameter-value banner

usage_rows.rationale: Help, diagnostic verbosity, and no-write preview are approved invocation controls.
Environment and compute-resource controls form one execution setup row.
The workflow discriminant and the calculation it selects remain adjacent.
Input interpretation and reference selection are one readable input row.
The required and conditional alignment collections are one input group.
The output target and its lifecycle controls form one output row.
siQ metadata and equation controls form one mode-specific row.
Fragment and depth controls form one structured mode-specific row.
The established finite numeric-rendering control remains separate.
Log destination and job naming controls form one operational row.
Concurrency and scheduler controls form one final execution row.
